info.name: The Little Prince that Loves the Stars

descriptions.notStarted: I remember seeing a boy sitting in the middle of the desert with a rose. He must not have been thirsty, because he kept worrying about the rose. I wonder if he's doing alright. I better go see him.
descriptions.inProgress: The strange boy was gazing up on the sky, then said to me in a sad tone, that he can't see a star. A star? What kind of a star is he looking at? I felt pretty sad watching him make a sad face wondering why he can't see a star, so I promised him I'll get #b#t4000333##k from #r#o2100108##k so he can see his star.  \n\n#i4000333# #t4000333#  #b#c4000333##k/20
descriptions.completed: After I gave that strange boy the #t4000333#, he flashed that bright smile of his. He said he's from a different planet... what does he mean? Is he an alien? He's hard to understand, but seeing him smile like that made me feel less weird about him.
